quotes.text: By constructing a digital twin framework that integrates multi-source data and high-fidelity models, dynamic perception and bidirectional interaction with the physical system are realized.

This research proposes a collaborative decision-making mechanism based on agent-based modeling and reinforcement learning, and focuses on exploring its application in key scenarios such as dynamic warehouse reservation and emergency logistics channel guarantee.

ft_note: Paywall Springer (LNEE vol. 1595, paquete 'Springer Nature Proceedings excluding Computer Science'): el proxy de Hull sigue mostrando solo el resumen ('preview of subscription content'). Semantic Scholar no indexa el DOI (sin copia OA). Se requiere PDF manual (Tec/compra) antes de codificar; por resumen parece candidato a inclusión (gemelo + ABM/RL + logística urbana).
